title: What Taste Film Experiences Is
definition: Taste Film Experiences: films paired with tasting menus.
description:
Strip Taste Film Experiences to its essence and you get films paired with tasting menus. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Entertainment & Play: first taste pairing understanding, then experience logistics prototypes, then flavor scores operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of experience hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

title: Real Research Today: Taste Film Experiences

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed taste pairing demonstrations, experience logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting flavor scores uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Taste Film Experiences
definition: Estimates Taste Film Experiences readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Taste Film Experiences components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a experience hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Taste Film Experiences Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Taste Film Experiences operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Taste Film Experiences installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 99792 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where taste pairing monitoring, experience logistics redundancy, or flavor scores maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Taste Film Experiences Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Taste Film Experiences: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Taste Film Experiences — films paired with tasting menus.

Phase 1 — Prove (taste pairing): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (experience logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (flavor scores): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (chef collabs): experience hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and audiences-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
